Overview

A car concept created for extreme winter driving

MOSHN is a snow-first vehicle concept built around a simple promise: when winter conditions become harsh, the car should adapt with you. Instead of relying only on external tools, MOSHN integrates intelligent systems directly into the vehicle to improve safety, mobility, and control.

Snow-first design

Engineered for deep snow, freezing temperatures, and low-traction roads.

Smart by default

Built with sensors and AI to monitor conditions and respond automatically.

Confident mobility

Helps drivers keep moving when traditional cars would struggle or stop.

Features

Technology designed to answer winter instantly

MOSHN combines AI-supported decision making with mechanical winter tools, creating a vehicle that reads the road and reacts in real time.

01

AI Snow Control

Analyzes road temperature, traction levels, snow depth, and vehicle stability.

02

Intelligent Tire Pressure

Adjusts tire pressure for stronger snow grip and smoother performance on clear roads.

03

Retractable Needle Traction

Deploys micro-spikes when icy conditions demand stronger contact with the road.

04

Wheel Heating System

Helps prevent ice buildup and supports tire flexibility in freezing weather.

05

Automated Snow Shovel

Integrated into the front bumper to help clear snow and create a path forward.

06

Driver-Focused Interface

Displays snow mode, wheel status, and traction feedback in a simple smart dashboard.

Technology

Three steps. One intelligent winter response.

MOSHN follows a smart operating cycle that keeps the experience simple for the driver. It detects changes, makes decisions, and activates the right support system.
1

Detect

Sensors track snow buildup, temperature, traction changes, and vehicle balance.

2

Decide

The onboard AI evaluates the conditions and selects the best support mode instantly.

3

Respond

MOSHN activates traction spikes, pressure control, heating, or the shovel when needed.
